alexcrichton opened PR #14915 from alexcrichton:adjust-scheme to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit is a minor adjustment to #14898 to avoid using the scheme of the request target and instead unconditionally use "http" as the scheme of the connection itself. This mirrors what wasip2 does and means that a request can't accidentally be mistaken as https, for example, when it was actually sent over http.
